row.notes: In Game_GarageCrewModule_SpawnGarageCrew (0x140388cf0), after the loop over the session assignment records (session+0x50, +0x1d0..+0x1d8 begin/end, step 0x98: entrant copy, +0x88 garage, +0x90 slot byte). The loop pushes a 16-byte entry {record*, slot dword} for each record whose garage id (garage+0x28) equals the spawn argument (ebp); rcx = vector begin, r13 = vector end (0x140389310 is the empty case). The crew loop then stores crew instance number r14d (the index in this vector) at [rsp+r14d*8+0x290] (0x14038944c) with no bound, but that array holds two pointers and the slot after them (+0x2a0) is the vector pointer the epilogue frees through GAME_DEFAULT (0x14038c7f4), so a garage with a third record (slots 0,1,2) overwrites it: fatal Invalid address for this heap. Sess_Set_GarageSlotEntrant_Thunk already ignores slot >= 2. Patch window 0x140389314..0x14038931a (mov r8,r13; sub r8,rcx); 0x14038930e jumps to its first byte and no branch lands inside. Core compacts the vector to its first two entries with slot < 2 by lowering r13. Raised by crew from the exe bytes; needs an independent agree row from the game lane owner before the binding exports.  Verified agree V3853 by kbverify-crew1 (independent disasm); L2 promoted by lead authorisation.
